classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design 2 compact binder candidates against a user-supplied target PDB (one per BindCraft trajectory shard), evaluate each with Boltz-2 affinity prediction, rank by predicted affinity, and surface the top-ranked candidate with minimal GPU overhead.
assumptions: target_pdb must be an absolute local path to a .pdb file; a PDB ID or URL requires a prior fetch step not included here.
target_sequence (target chain) must be supplied by the user or extracted by the executor from target_pdb before the Boltz-2 step; it is required to build the complex input.
binder_length defaults to 60 aa; adjust via workflow param if a different length is desired.
Two BindCraft trajectory shards (seed 1 and seed 2) follow the tool's recommended_shard_size=1 and default_max_parallel=2, yielding one candidate per shard.
num_recycles=1 minimises per-trajectory GPU time; increasing to 3-4 improves backbone quality at higher cost.
Boltz-2 runs with diffusion_samples=1 and use_msa=false for speed; affinity_pred_value is the primary ranking signal.
filter_mode=default preserves upstream BindCraft quality thresholds; switch to permissive if neither shard produces a passing design.
No hotspot residues are specified; BindCraft explores the full interface of target_chain. Supplying hotspots would focus and accelerate the search.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: absolute path to the target .pdb structure file (required by bindcraft)
target_sequence: amino acid sequence of the target chain (required by boltz2_affinity to construct the complex; can be extracted from target_pdb by the executor if not provided separately)

success_criteria.affinity_scored: boltz2_affinity.affinity_pred_value populated for every evaluated design
success_criteria.ranked_tsv_written: rank_designs.ranked_tsv file produced for downstream inspection
success_criteria.top_candidate_quality: top-ranked candidate has confidence_score and plddt_per_residue available from boltz2_affinity
